items.notes: Curmudgeon c5 flagged: WIN-053 uses B(r)=A*e^(-r_N/lambda)+C*e^(-r_S/lambda), WIN-040 uses H(r)=8537*exp(-r/8619), both for the same axial-symmetry point. items.notes: Surviving defense (defense_survives=3/5): dome defender could argue our critique conflates the author's theological-consistency use of CONFIRMED with a verified-by-measurement definition, framing the disagreement as semantic not scientific.
